answer: Each bonded identity escrows collateral, but splitting stake across aliases does not dilute risk: when k coordinated identities equivocate on the same conflicting state, correlated penalties scale as O(k²), rather than O(k). Detection compounds slashing with asymmetric collateral depreciation, imposing an exponential multiplier on swarm capital loss. An ivory audit log preserves evidence; a zenith-risk threshold triggers review, while a haven for honest recovery cannot erase finalized proof.
